open_with: Open by validating her call on gold/commodities directly — she read that trade right, and it's worth saying so plainly as one peer to another. Use that credibility as the bridge into the portfolio math: at 14.04% the position has grown past a balanced allocation, and now the conversation is about sizing the win, not questioning the thesis. From there, pivot to the 2027 succession/notarial funding need (EUR 850,000) and point out there's no mandate currently structured to deliver that cash on schedule — this is the more urgent architecture problem to solve together today.
do_not_lead_with: Don't lead with the 0–10% band or frame this as a compliance/breach issue — there's no restriction or sensitivity flagging it, so opening there reads as risk-department hand-wringing rather than peer-level portfolio strategy. That undercuts the tone and puts her on the defensive about a call that's actually worked out. Also don't bury the succession funding gap as an afterthought — treat it as equally load-bearing, not a minor admin note.
